title: Statistics, B.S. (Eberly College of Science)
notes: Built from the archived 2024-2025 bulletin (https://bulletins.psu.edu/archive/2024-2025/undergraduate/colleges/eberly-science/statistics-bs/), fetched directly. Suggested Academic Plan course-by-semester sequence (MATH 140/STAT 200/STAT 184 in Year 1 Fall per the bulletin's own suggestion; MATH 141/STAT 300 in Year 1 Spring; MATH 220/MATH 230/CMPSC 131/STAT 380 in Year 2 Fall; STAT 414/STAT 463/CMPSC 132 in Year 2 Spring; STAT 415/STAT 400/CMPSC 221 in Year 3 Fall; STAT 440/CMPSC 465/CMPSC 360 in Year 3 Spring; CMPSC 448/STAT 466/CMPSC 442 in Year 4 Fall; STAT 470W/STAT 480/CMPSC 455 in Year 4 Spring) and prescribed-course list match the 2026 edition course-for-course. Two real, verified differences found for this year: (1) the 'Select 12 credits from the following' Advanced elective pool verbatim-quoted from the archive page includes 'RM 415 Modeling for Actuarial Science' and 'RM 420 Property, Casualty, and Health Insurance' in addition to every option 2026 still has -- these two Risk Management courses were dropped from the pool by the 2025 or 2026 edition (both confirmed RM-free, see STAT-2025.json's notes). Added both to this file's 4 shared-option-pool 'Advanced STAT/CMPSC elective' slots and added RM to the departments list so the engine can actually surface them. (2) 'Supporting Courses and Related Areas' reads 'Select 9 credits from department list' here, not 8 -- modeled as 3 open_elective slots of 3 credits each (9 total) instead of 2026's 3+3+2 split. Same MATH 3 -> MATH 4 -> MATH 21 -> STAT 200/STAT 184 prereq-chain fix as STAT-2026.json applied here too: Backend/catalogs/stat_catalog.json is a single file shared by every catalog-year plan (STAT 200 and STAT 184 both carry a real literal prereq_groups [['MATH 21']] there, independent of catalog_year), so without this fix STAT 200/184 would be prereq-blocked in Semester 1 here exactly as they were found to be in the unfixed 2026 file.

items.label: MATH 3 (unlocks MATH 4, needed for MATH 21's own real prereq chain)
MATH 4 (unlocks MATH 21's real prereq chain, needs MATH 3 first)
Advanced STAT/CMPSC elective (department list) -- pick 1 of 4
items.notes: Wired 2026-09 per the archived 2024-2025 bulletin's real, fully-enumerated Statistics and Computing Option 'Select 12 credits from the following' list, quoted verbatim from the archive page: BBH/HPA 440 (Principles of Epidemiology), CMPSC 448 (Machine Learning and Algorithmic AI), IE 434 (Statistical Quality Control), IE 436 (Six Sigma Methodology), MATH 436 (Linear Algebra) or MATH 441 (Matrix Algebra), MATH/CMPSC 451 (Numerical Computations) or MATH/CMPSC 455 (Introduction to Numerical Analysis I), RM 415 (Modeling for Actuarial Science), RM 420 (Property, Casualty, and Health Insurance), STAT/MATH 416 (Stochastic Modeling), STAT 440 (Computational Statistics), STAT 463 (Applied Time Series Analysis), STAT 464 (Applied Nonparametric Statistics), STAT 466 (Survey Sampling). RM 415/420 are real 2024 options that the 2026 edition's own pool no longer lists (see STAT-2026.json's notes) -- added here for historical accuracy; both exist in Backend/catalogs/rm_catalog.json (RM 415 needs RM 410, RM 420 needs RM 412 -- neither is elsewhere in this plan, so in practice the engine will still recommend from the other 17 options, same as any STAT major who hasn't taken the actuarial-science prereq chain).
